fusions.name: Barbed Polyp
fusions.desc: Fires a coral-barbed arrow that deals 4 water damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Spawning Tide
fusions.desc: Looses a coral-headed arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 water damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Reef Spire
fusions.desc: Grows a coral spire that stands for 15 seconds and looses a barb at an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Calcifying Wounds
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, a shield worth 10% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
